_readme: QUEENSTOWN FIXED-PRICE MENU. EVERY PRICE HERE IS A PLACEHOLDER.
Replace each price with your real number, then change placeholderPrices to false.
Prices are in whole dollars and include GST.
ownerPriceDollars is what the owner's card is charged. tradiePayoutDollars is what the tradie receives.
The gap between the two is what the platform keeps. The placeholders use a 15% platform fee.
licenceRequired must be true for any plumbing, gas or electrical work.
This file is loaded into the database in Phase 2. Nothing uses it before then.
